self_assessment.weakest_area: Hero description is left-aligned while title is centered, creating slight visual asymmetry. Collection card title lacks hover color change (group class missing on parent). Mock avatars use ui-avatars.com initials which are functional but not visually rich.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Kept the homepage minimal with no fancy animations or gradients, trusting the editorial warmth and people-first layout to carry the design. Resisted adding glassmorphism from the frost theme.

known_limitations: No entrance animations yet (motion-v installed but unused)
GitHub icon uses i-lucide-github instead of i-simple-icons-github (may need icon collection)
